confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not a live price check. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is less certain and includes Sri Lanka's service charge and VAT/SSCL uplift. Drink prices are uncertain because of high alcohol taxes and import duties. Beer is the anchor; wine and cocktail are set by local price relationships to beer. The FX observation comes from an RBA exchange-rates search excerpt that I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized South Asian tourist cities, adjusted upward for Colombo's higher-priced hotels, restaurants and imported drinks. Accommodation anchors assume taxes and mandatory fees are included. July is in the southwest monsoon period, but Colombo's pricing is not strongly seasonal, so no off-season adjustment is applied.
